posts.title: Be Brave and Obey God
posts.excerpt:
If you’re being honest, have you ever struggled to obey God, because it would be easier to not
do so – to keep the peace with people around you, or avoid friction? I can admit I have.

In the book of 2 Kings, there’s a story about this very issue.
“Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in
Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its
construction” (2 Kings. 16:10).
